turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good idea.

Present continuous: **am/is/are + verb-ing**, for actions happening now.
Example: Two children are playing football.

Exercise: Imagine a park. Write one sentence about what a person is doing now.

guardRaw.sentence: Write one sentence about what a person is doing now.
